title: I Learned to Read Again
summary: A personal essay exploring the author's journey of rediscovering the ability to read deeply after struggling with reduced attention span and distraction in the digital age. The piece likely discusses practical methods for reclaiming focus and the transformative power of returning to sustained reading.
problem_solved: Addresses the modern struggle of maintaining focus and deep reading in an era of constant digital distraction
why_valuable: Offers personal insights and practical approaches for anyone feeling they've lost their ability to concentrate and engage with long-form content
